applyMaterialV2 sets texture repeat directly from positive x/y (optionally multiplied by scale), sets center to 0.5/0.5, and converts source mapping.rotation from degrees using MathUtils.degToRad. This confirms rotation units independently of UI assumptions.

Current source renderer accepts numeric physical material settings, color fields and normalScale. The observed product API data subset was preserved in catalog enrichment; absent values are not invented source configuration.
